novelChapterText.text: The letter was there again, tucked under the sugar jar, the way it always was on Tuesdays.

Sreyna saw it before she had even turned on the lights. Pale blue paper, folded twice, her name written in the careful, slightly leaning hand she had started to recognise from across the room. Outside, the street was still waking up — a tuk-tuk idling at the corner, a woman setting out plastic stools for the noodle stall, the river a grey line behind the buildings.
She made herself start the coffee first. Fill the kettle. Grind the beans. Wipe the counter that did not need wiping. Only when the first cup was poured did she slide the letter out and unfold it.
“You asked what I’m afraid of. I think it’s this: that one Tuesday I’ll come in and the jar will be empty, and I’ll never know why.”
She read it twice. Then a third time, more slowly, as if the words might change if she let them sit.

By eight o’clock the café was full. Students with their laptops, two monks sheltering from the heat, the old man who ordered iced tea and never drank more than half. Sreyna moved between the tables with the letter folded in her apron pocket, a small, steady weight.
Dara, who ran the bakery next door and had opinions about everything, leaned over the counter. “You’re smiling at the milk frother.”
“You are. Is it the letter person?”

She did not answer, which was an answer. Dara laughed and went back to her croissants, and Sreyna caught herself looking at every customer who came through the door — the man in the grey shirt, the girl with the camera, the delivery rider who always said thank you twice — wondering, for the first time, which of them was paying attention.

That night she wrote back on the last sheet of her good paper. She wrote about the river, and about her grandmother, and about how being afraid of an empty jar meant you had already decided the jar was worth something.
Then, at the bottom, smaller, before she could talk herself out of it:
“Next Tuesday, stay for a coffee. I’ll know it’s you.”

creatorNote: Thank you for reading! The café in this story is based on a real one near Wat Phnom. See you next Tuesday.

helpArticles.a: Fast Pass lets you read the newest episodes before they’re free. Each Fast Pass episode costs 5 coins. Every episode becomes free for everyone 7 days after it comes out.
Go to Coins, pick a pack, and pay with KHQR, ABA Pay or a card. Your first purchase gives you double coins. Coins arrive in a few seconds.
No. Coins you buy never expire. Bonus coins from events may have an end date, which we show when you get them.

helpArticles.q: I paid but didn’t get my coins
helpArticles.a: Most payments confirm within seconds. If it’s been more than 10 minutes, send us a message with your order number (it starts with TW-). We’ll check with the bank and add your coins or refund you.
Coins you haven’t spent can be refunded within the refund period. Coins already spent on episodes can’t be refunded. If you were charged twice or a payment failed, we refund it in full.
helpArticles.linkLabel: Read the coins and refunds policy

helpArticles.a: On the Log in page, tap “Forgot password?”, enter your email, and we’ll send you a 6-digit code to set a new password.

helpArticles.q: How do I change my name or language?
helpArticles.a: Open Settings. Your display name is under Account, and the app language (English or ខ្មែរ) is under Language and region.

helpArticles.q: How do I delete my account?
helpArticles.a: Open Settings → Account actions → Delete account. This deletes your library, comments and unused coins, and can’t be undone.

helpArticles.q: Images load slowly or look blurry
helpArticles.a: Check your connection, then set Image quality to Automatic in Settings → Reading. On mobile data, “Data saver” loads smaller images.

helpArticles.q: How do I get alerts for new episodes?
helpArticles.a: Subscribe to a series. You’ll get a notification when a new episode comes out. Choose push or email in Notifications → Alert settings.

helpArticles.q: How do I publish my comic or novel?
helpArticles.a: Open Creator studio → New series, add the details, summary and cover, then submit it for review. We check new series within 1–2 days. Then upload your first episode.

helpArticles.q: What image size should episodes be?
helpArticles.a: Use JPG or PNG, 690–1600 px wide, up to 20 MB per image. Upload them in reading order; you can reorder before publishing.
You earn when readers spend coins on your Fast Pass episodes. Add a payout method in Earnings. Payout amounts and dates follow the creator agreement.

helpArticles.q: How do I report a comment or series?
helpArticles.a: Tap “Report” next to a comment, or “Report it” on a series’ About tab. Choose a reason and send. We review reports within 24 hours. Reports are anonymous.
Tap “Block” next to their comment or on their profile. You won’t see their comments and they can’t reply to you. Unblock them any time in Settings → Privacy and safety.
Turn airplane mode off, then turn Wi-Fi or mobile data off and on again. The page reconnects by itself when you’re back online.
Try refreshing the page or updating your browser. If it still doesn’t work, send us a message with a screenshot and what you were trying to do.

sections: What we collect
Account details: name, email, birth year and app language.
Reading activity: series you subscribe to, episodes you read, likes and comments.
Purchases: order numbers, coin amounts and payment status. Card and bank details are handled by [PAYMENT PROVIDER].
Device information: browser, app version and approximate location from your IP address, used for security and region availability.
How we use it
To run your account and library, send the alerts you choose, process coin purchases, keep PhumiReader safe, and improve the service.
Creators see totals (views, likes, subscribers), not who you are.
Who we share it with
Service providers who help us run PhumiReader: hosting ([HOSTING PROVIDER]), email ([EMAIL PROVIDER]) and payments ([PAYMENT PROVIDER]).
Authorities, when the law requires it.

We keep your data while your account is open. After you delete your account, we remove personal data within [RETENTION PERIOD], except records we must keep by law, such as payment records.
Your choices

Turn notifications on or off in Notifications → Alert settings.
Children

Contact

refund.title: Coins and refunds
summary: Coins you buy never expire.
Unused coins can be refunded within [REFUND WINDOW] days of purchase.
Coins already spent on episodes can’t be refunded.

sections: How coins work
You buy coins in packs and spend them to unlock Fast Pass episodes (5 coins each). Every Fast Pass episode becomes free for everyone after 7 days. Unlocked episodes stay in your library.
Refunds for unused coins
If you haven’t spent the coins from a purchase, you can ask for a refund within [REFUND WINDOW] days. Bonus and first-purchase coins are removed when the pack is refunded.
Payment problems

If you were charged but didn’t get coins, or were charged twice, contact us with your order number (TW-…). We check with the bank and either add the coins or refund the payment to the same method, usually within [REFUND TIME].
How to ask for a refund
Go to Help center → Contact us, choose “Coins or payment”, and add your order number. You’ll find it in Coins → Purchase history.
What we can’t refund
Coins already spent, coins from events or promotions, and purchases older than [REFUND WINDOW] days, unless the law requires it.

community.label: Community guidelines
community.title: Community guidelines
summary: Be kind. Disagree with ideas, not people.
Warn before spoilers.
Only post work you made or have the right to share.
Report anything that breaks these rules. Reports are anonymous.
sections: Be respectful
No harassment, bullying, threats or insults. No hate speech against anyone’s ethnicity, religion, gender, disability or any other part of who they are.
Keep it safe
Never post sexual content involving anyone under 18. We remove it and report it to the authorities.
No content that encourages self-harm, violence or dangerous acts.
No sharing other people’s private information, like phone numbers or addresses.
Respect creators
Don’t re-upload or claim someone else’s work. Don’t post leaks of Fast Pass episodes.
Give feedback that helps. Creators read your comments.
Spoilers and spam
Don’t reveal what happens in later episodes without a warning.
No ads, link spam, repeated comments or fake accounts.
What happens if rules are broken
Depending on how serious it is, we may remove the content, give a warning, limit commenting, or close the account. Very serious cases, like content harming children, lead to an immediate ban.
If you think we made a mistake, contact us and we’ll look again.
How to report
Tap “Report” next to a comment, on a profile, or on a series’ About tab. Choose a reason and send. We review reports within 24 hours. You can follow your reports in Settings → Privacy and safety.
If someone is in danger right now, contact local emergency services. In Cambodia: police 117, ambulance 119.

creator.label: Creator guidelines
creator.title: Creator guidelines
summary: Publish only your original work, or work you have the rights to.
Choose an honest age rating.
Covers and summaries can’t contain contact details, ads or watermarks.
New series are reviewed within 1–2 days before they go live.
sections: Original work
Only publish comics and stories you made, or have written permission to publish. Fan works must follow [FAN WORK POLICY].
Use of AI-generated images or text: [AI CONTENT POLICY].
Age ratings
All ages: fine for everyone. 13+: mild violence or language. 16+: stronger themes. 18+: only shown to adults who turn on mature series. Sexual content involving anyone under 18 is never allowed.
Covers, titles and summaries
Covers must be 3:4, at least 1080 × 1440 px, with no borders or watermarks. Titles and summaries can’t include phone numbers, social handles, links or ads.
Episodes
Comics: JPG or PNG, 690–1600 px wide, up to 20 MB per image. Web novels: at least 300 words per chapter.
Keep your schedule. If you need a break, set the series to hiatus so readers know.
Review and changes requested
We review new series within 1–2 days. If something needs fixing, we’ll tell you exactly what, and you can resubmit right away.
Earnings
You earn from coins readers spend on your Fast Pass episodes, at [REVENUE SHARE]% as set out in the creator agreement. Payouts follow [PAYOUT SCHEDULE].
